Speak With Your Alive Coach!
A calm, supportive conversation to help you choose the right retreat
You don’t need to have it all figured out before you speak to me.
This is a relaxed, confidential conversation with an Alive wellness and life coach designed to help you feel clear, supported and confident about your next step.
There is no pressure, no obligation and no sales agenda. Just guidance, answers and a sense of what’s possible for you.
What this conversation is for?
Most guests come to this call feeling one (or more) of the following:
ready for health changes
overwhelmed or burnt out
ready for a reset or detox
craving emotional clarity or healing
wanting to reconnect with themselves
unsure which retreat, location or program is right
This call helps you move from uncertainty to clarity quickly and gently.
What we’ll explore together...
🌿 Your retreat vision
We’ll talk about what’s drawing you here right now.
Whether that’s wellness, detox, emotional healing, stress relief, life reset, or simply time and space to breathe.
You don’t need the “right words”. We’ll guide the conversation.
🌍 Location & timing
We’ll help you choose the best location for you (Bali, Mexico), talk through travel logistics, and share how quickly you could arrive if timing matters.
Our travel concierge makes the process simple and stress-free.
🧘♀️ Your personalised retreat experience
We’ll explain how our signature Alive program works and how it can be tailored to you including:
daily wellness, movement, yoga and mindfulness
fitness and movement
nature and adventure
emotional and energetic healing
life coaching and clarity workshops
optional one-to-one therapies and deeper support
health sessions
You’ll leave the call understanding what your retreat could look and feel like, not just what’s included.
🏡 Accommodation & style
We’ll help you choose:
luxury private suite or villa
small group retreat with personal support
or a fully private, confidential experience
You’ll understand the different styles and what suits you best.
🍃 Food & nourishment
We’ll talk through our approach to nourishment and how dietary needs can be fully personalised gently, intuitively and without rigidity.
💫 Your life, gently understood
If you wish, we can also explore:
how stress, lifestyle or life transitions may be affecting you
what support you already have and what you may be missing
what kind of reset would feel most nourishing right now
This is not about labels, diagnosis or analysing you. It’s about understanding you where you are, and where you’d like to be.
💰 Pricing & next steps
Every Alive retreat is created uniquely.
On the call, we’ll:
explain starting prices clearly
talk through options that fit your needs and budget
outline next steps if and when you feel ready
Many guests tell us they feel lighter and clearer by the end of this conversation — even before booking anything.
Before the call (optional)
If you choose, you’ll receive a short 3-minute questionnaire before we speak. It simply helps us understand what you’re looking for so the call feels focused, personal and supportive.
This conversation is for you if:
you want clarity without pressure
you’re curious but not yet committed
you want to feel supported, not sold to
you’d like to speak with a real human who understands this journey
We look forward to meeting you and supporting you — wherever you are on your path.
With warmth,
The Alive Team
